faqs.question: What if I miss a session?
faqs.answer: All sessions are recorded. You'll have access to recordings for 6 months. However, we strongly recommend attending live for the interactive practice and peer feedback.

faqs.question: How is this different from 1-on-1 coaching?
faqs.answer: The cohort provides peer learning, accountability, and community that 1-on-1 can't match. You'll learn from others' mistakes and successes, practice with peers, and build connections. It's also more affordable at $100/session vs $140+ for 1-on-1.

faqs.question: What's the cohort size?
faqs.answer: We limit each cohort to 8-12 participants. This ensures everyone gets personalized attention while benefiting from group dynamics.

faqs.question: Do I need to prepare anything before starting?
faqs.answer: You'll receive a pre-work package one week before we start. It includes a self-assessment and initial story collection exercise. Expect to spend 2-3 hours on pre-work.

faqs.question: What if I'm not happy with the program?
faqs.answer: Attend all 5 sessions and put in the work. If you don't feel significantly more prepared, I'll personally work with you 1-on-1 until you do. Your success is my reputation.

faqs.question: Can I do this while working full-time?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Sessions are on Saturdays specifically for working professionals. Expect to spend an additional 3-4 hours per week on practice and homework between sessions.

glossary.title: Industry Terms Explained
glossary.subtitle: New to tech interview terminology? Here's what these terms mean.

terms.definition: Facebook (now Meta), Amazon, Apple, Netflix, Google — the top-tier tech companies known for rigorous interviews and high compensation.
Situation, Task, Action, Result — a framework for structuring behavioral interview answers to clearly demonstrate your impact.
An experienced interviewer (often from a different team) who ensures hiring standards stay high. They have veto power over hiring decisions.
Leadership Principles — Amazon's 16 core values used to evaluate candidates in every interview. Other companies have similar frameworks.
Individual Contributor — a technical role without direct reports, like Senior Engineer, Staff Engineer, or Principal Engineer.
Vice President — a senior leadership role typically overseeing multiple teams or an entire department.
A leadership role managing multiple teams of engineers or managers, typically 20-50+ people.
Senior IC roles equivalent to Director/VP level in impact, but focused on technical leadership rather than people management.
Interview round where you design large-scale systems (like Twitter or Uber) to demonstrate architectural thinking and trade-off analysis.
The full-day onsite interview, typically 4-6 back-to-back interviews covering technical, behavioral, and leadership topics.
